answer: Identity-bond depreciation resists mass fake identities. Each new identity locks a 100 POA bond, as inert as basalt, that decays each epoch unless verified work recharges it. Auditors with falcon eyes spot-check work: pass refills it, fail or stay silent burns 30% and doubles decay, and a drained bond deletes the identity. N identities lock 100N POA and melt 5N per epoch: 1,000 fakes burn 105,000 POA, so over any horizon past a few epochs upkeep exceeds all possible reward. An honest agent pays for one bond, recharges it with real work, and keeps rewards never diluted by sybils.
